svg.title: SOVA cross-model KV cache transfer architecture
svg.desc: The same prompt is evaluated by a native large-model path and a transfer path. A smaller Qwen3 model reads the prefix; a fitted mapper translates its keys and values; the larger Qwen3 model imports the cache, processes one tail token and generates an answer. A proposed SageMaker GPU worker reads inputs from S3 and returns traces, quality scores and timing to S3. Motion illustrates flow, not measured latency.
svg.text: Translate the prefix state instead of asking the target to read it all again.

g.text: Target reads the full N-token prompt.
Builds its own cache before answering

svg.text: Transfer / source prefix to target state
Native and transferred answers are scored on the same held-out questions.

g.text: Proposed AWS worker / no deployment launched
Job exits after artifacts are saved

svg.text: Initial adapter: dense Qwen3. Hybrid Qwen3.5/3.8 needs recurrent-state support.
Motion illustrates sequence, not measured speed.
